follow_up.reference: Choose and document either a partial-window mean or an unavailable result. The current examples already contain enough observations for the requested full window.

instances.text: Prices are 53, 120, 132, 171, 117, 85, 101, 59. What is the mean of the last 3 observations, as an exact fraction?
instances.spoken_text: Prices are fifty-three, one hundred and twenty, one hundred and thirty-two, one hundred and seventy-one, one hundred and seventeen, eighty-five, one hundred and one, fifty-nine. What is the mean of the last three observations, as an exact fraction?

follow_up.question: Why is an observation-count window different from a time-duration window?
follow_up.reference: Irregular timestamps can put different numbers of observations into the same elapsed period. A time window must expire observations by timestamp rather than only by count.
